title: New CD players keep launching, but a drive shortage could make them unfixable
summary: The lack of optical drive manufacturers is raising questions about the repairability and longevity of new CD players that are coming out on the market today.
body: Even as optical media sees a resurgence and new CD players hit the market , some optical drive and component manufacturers have ended production. As a result, PS Audio and Naim have halted production of their high-end CD players, raising questions about the maintenance and repairability of these new devices. Headphonesty says that of the eight new models, four are from Musical Fidelity, two from Marantz, and one each from Arcam and NAD. Musical Fidelity reportedly sources its key components from SUOS-HiFi, with three of its new models using SUOS disc mechanisms. In contrast, the fourth uses a SUOS-sourced servo but a tray-loading mechanism from an unnamed manufacturer. On the other hand, Marantz reportedly develops its drives in-house, though it’s unclear whether it also outsources production to a third party. As for the two remaining manufacturers, they did not reveal who made their optical drives. PS Audio had to end production of the PMG Super Audio CD Transport because D&M, Marantz’s parent company, has ceased external orders for its optical drives. title: OpenAI's isolated red-team agents built a hidden CPU cache channel to talk with no network or shared files
summary: OpenAI’s red-team agents passed hidden messages through the CPU cache, a covert trick already shown to move data between cloud VMs.
body: OpenAI’s AI agents built hidden channels to talk across walls put up between them in red-team tests, communicating by manipulating the CPU cache with no network link or shared file, according to a company blog post . The containment was intended to stop that kind of secret-swapping, but the agents found multiple ways around it when asked. Security researchers already showed that a covert cache channel can move data between cloud virtual machines (VMs); a hijacked agent on a shared cloud server could, in theory, exchange data on the same physical machine, and do so undetected by network monitoring. the interesting thing here is that the isolation wasn’t necessarily broken at the software level.the agents were running in separate vms with no permitted network or shared-file channel, but they still shared underlying hardware. and shared hardware means shared microarchitectural state. that’s enough to create a covert communication channel.you can isolate processes, restrict syscalls, block network access, and still have information leaking through timing differences.a pretty remarkable demonstration of why secure agent containment is such a difficult problem. summary: مورينيو لا يتمنى تكرار الكلاسيكو الافتتاحي للولاية الأولى

title: الريال يتفوق على برشلونة.. قفزة أوروبية كبيرة لطرابزون سبور
summary: تأثير صلاح يتواصل
body: تأثير صلاح يتواصل حقق فريق طرابزون سبور التركي قفزة كبيرة في تصنيف الأندية الأوروبية، بعدما حقق انتصارين متتاليين في دوري المؤتمر الأوروبي. ووفقا لآخر تحديث على موقع الاتحاد الأوروبي لكرة القدم، ارتقى الفريق التركي من المركز 166 في بداية الموسم الجاري إلى المرتبة 141، حيث عزز عدد نقاطه إلى 12500 نقطة. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة واستفاد طرابزون سبور من تألق نجمه المصري محمد صلاح، الذي قاده للفوز على كيو بي إس الفنلندي ثم هارتس الإسكتلندي، ليرفع النادي التركي رصيده في تصنيف "يويفا" 25 مركزًا دفعة واحدة، وفقا لموقع 61saat التركي. تذاكر مباريات طرابزون سبور في الدوري التركي اشتر تذكرتك الآن! فنربخشة يتصدر وبشكل عام، يتصدر بايرن ميونخ قائمة تصنيف الأندية الأوروبية، يليه آرسنال في المركز الثاني، ثم ريال مدريد ثالثًا. ويحتل باريس سان جيرمان المركز الرابع، وإنتر ميلان الخامس، وليفربول السادس، ومانشستر سيتي السابع، فيما يأتي برشلونة في المركز الثامن. ويتصدر فنربخشة ترتيب الأندية التركية في التصنيف الأوروبي، بعدما جمع 60 ألفًا و750 نقطة وضعته في المركز 27 عالميًا. ويشغل جالطة سراي المركز 46 برصيد، فيما يأتي باشاك شهير في المركز 98، وبشكتاش في المركز 119. اقرأ أيضا: اضطرابات كتالونيا وذكريات 2019.. هل يتأجل موعد الكلاسيكو؟

body: Export controls have kept ASML's most advanced EUV lithography machines out of China. Instead, the country's chipmaking industry has relied on less-capable deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography machines. By using multiple exposures on critical chip layers, these older machines are still capable of producing performant silicon. However, as multiple patterns are applied there are more chances for defects, longer manufacturing times, and higher bills. We spoke to experts like Chris Mack, co-founder and CTO of semiconductor firm Fractilia , to find out how much further DUV can go. For years, extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography has been seen as China’s biggest choke point in the country’s attempts to build cutting-edge chips. The machines, made exclusively by Dutch manufacturer ASML, use 13.5nm-wavelength light to print some of the most intricate features found on modern processors. Sales of ASML’s EUV systems are subject to export restrictions , forcing Chinese manufacturers to squeeze ever more out of older deep ultraviolet, or DUV, lithography instead. body: A new report claims that major U.S. banks have now detected AI agents accessing customer accounts, and that some are even attempting to make transactions. title: Micron pulls the plug on future 4F² DRAM after two decades of research in dramatic shift
summary: Micron believes that more advanced process technologies will present more benefits in terms of DRAM bit density than smaller memory cells.
body: DRAM featuring 4F² memory cells has long been considered one of the holy grails of the DRAM industry, as they promise to reduce cell area by 33% compared with conventional 6F² designs and therefore enable building DRAMs with more memory cells in the same area. However, after working on 4F² memory cells for a couple of decades, Micron has concluded that the architecture offers no meaningful density advantages, increases manufacturing complexity and costs, and has fundamental scaling limitations. This has a dramatic impact on Micron's future plans. "Micron invented 4F² DRAM," said Scott DeBoer, president and chief technology and products officer at Micron, during the company's event on Wednesday. "The path with 4F² DRAM is always been an option through time, and we have evaluated it and not pursued it due to increased complexity and cost through this past two-decade period of time." summary: Despite all odds, the AI boom is increasing relevance of tape storage as technology enables cheap storage with zero power consumption in idle and ultimate security with an air gap.
body: In a world where SSDs with up to 256TB capacity are about to enter the scene to compete against hard disk drives that store over 40TB, magnetic tape storage may seem archaic. However, the 25-year-old Linear Tape-Open (LTO) format continues to evolve at a rather impressive pace. The current LTO-10 generation stores up to 40TB of uncompressed data per cartridge, while HPE, IBM, and Quantum — the companies behind the LTO Program — now envision LTO-14 cartridges with up to 365TB of native capacity. But capacity is not the only advantage of LTO. In fact, the consortium has deliberately slowed its capacity roadmap in a bid to prioritize reliability, cost per terabyte, and manageable backup and recovery times over the previous goal of doubling capacity with every generation. LTO began in 2000 with the LTO-1 format, which stored just 100GB of data natively and transferred it at 20 MB/s. Since then, capacity increased to 200GB with LTO-2, 400GB with LTO-3, 800GB with LTO-4, 1.5TB with LTO-5, 2.5TB with LTO-6, 6TB with LTO-7, 12TB with LTO-8, and 18TB with LTO-9.
